title_zh: 拟定阅读试办计划并约定向园方确认

scenario.label_zh: 拟定幼儿园阅读试办及确认安排
scenario.goal_zh: 明确阅读试办的目标和单班范围，约定向教师确认带队、场地与方案后再启动

context_zh: 社区图书馆的贝拉与幼儿园联络人陈讨论联合阅读活动的试办。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: Would the kindergarten be interested in a joint reading project with the library?

sentences.speaker: Chen
sentences.text: Possibly. What would the children actually do?

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: Listen to one short story and choose a book to look at with an adult. Our mission is to make books feel welcoming, not to test anyone.

sentences.speaker: Chen
sentences.text: That fits. Who would take responsibility for the volunteers?

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: I can provide leadership on the library side, but a teacher should stay with the group.

sentences.speaker: Chen
sentences.text: I'll ask Ms Patel to lead the first session. Could we start with one class rather than the whole school?

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: Yes. Let's launch the pilot only after she confirms the room and agrees to the plan.

sentences.speaker: Chen
sentences.text: I'll take that plan to her tomorrow and let you know before we invite families.
